worked_example.problem: To which group does {t} belong, and what is it used for?
steps: It is used before cooking, so it is a preparing tool.
Its sharp holes cut food into small pieces or shreds (cassava, coconut, carrots).
worked_example.answer: A preparing tool, used to grate food into small pieces.

cards.idea: Small equipment are hand tools and utensils for preparing, cooking and serving food.
example: Pots and ladles are for cooking.

cards.idea: They are made of steel, aluminium, cast iron, enamel, wood, plastic, glass or clay.
example: Wooden spoons do not get hot.

cards.idea: A knife has a blade, a bolster and a handle; a saucepan has a body, a base, a lid and a handle.
example: The blade has the sharp edge.

check.prompt: Match each part to the tool it belongs to.

e: Food is cut on it before cooking.
It is not for keeping food.
It is used with hot food.
It does not cut or mix.
pick.y: It keeps food hot or cold.
It pounds pepper, groundnuts and fufu.

questions.prompt: Which group of small equipment does {X.q} belong to?
Match each tool to a material it is often made of.
Match each part to the tool it belongs to.

right.text: A grater is a preparing tool.
A ladle is used for soups.
Wooden spoons do not get very hot.
A sieve separates fine from coarse particles.

wrong.text: A refrigerator is a small kitchen tool.
A chopping board is used to serve soup.
wrong.explain: It is used to cut food on.

wrong.text: The blade of a knife is the part you hold.
wrong.explain: You hold the handle; the blade cuts.
